fieldMarks: Males dark brown above, white underparts, white eye patches; only males have spiral horns (50-61 cm, about 4 turns)
Females yellowish where males are dark
behavior: Gregarious herds of 5-50 led by a single male
Shy and wary, relies on vision
Active early morning and late afternoon in hot seasons
Can hold about 40 mph for long distances
habitat: Open woodland, semi-desert, thorn forest and dry deciduous forest near grassland.
range: Native to India and Pakistan. The ADW page does not describe North American introduced populations.
